## What managing Northbrook takes.

### Townhome capital cycles
Many Northbrook townhome communities are reaching overlapping replacement cycles for roofing, siding, windows, private roads, and common lighting. We turn the reserve study into a phased, board-approved operating plan.

### Shared-site operations
Private drives, detention and drainage areas, mature landscaping, snow removal, and shared exterior components require coordinated scopes and dependable seasonal vendors. We track each obligation before it becomes an emergency.

### Clear project and financial controls
Large exterior projects need comparable bids, documented approvals, invoice controls, owner communication, and progress reporting. Those controls are built into our monthly board process rather than added only after construction begins.

## Northbrook boards ask us first.

### Does CenterPoint specialize in Northbrook townhome and HOA management?
Yes. Our townhome and HOA programs cover shared-exterior maintenance, private-site operations, landscaping and snow, financial reporting, owner communication, governance support, and long-range reserve planning.

### Can CenterPoint oversee roofing, siding, or private-road projects in Northbrook?
Yes. We coordinate planning, bid scopes, contractor comparisons, board approvals, schedules, invoices, owner notices, and progress reporting. CenterPoint does not charge a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Northbrook?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Northbrook (ZIP 60062). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Northbrook?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Northbrook association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access.
